assessments.reasoning: The ASF plaintext capture matches the claimed publisher SHA-256. Its comment delimiters identify the complete example body independently of the SPDX wording and provide a reproducible boundary for the comparison.

The commit-pinned Apache-1.1.json in spdx/license-list-data supplies the identifier, name, and literal licenseText used in the calculation. Its full capture SHA-256 is 65a343cd572051e82a33e58d4b2014ea0679a4e4cb814e55a76ac32c38a29279. The template, HTML, and cross-reference metadata are separately identified fields.

GitHub's API for spdx/license-list-data identifies 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b as the annotated tag object named v3.29.0. Its object.sha identifies 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 as the target commit. This establishes the repository's release-to-revision link.

challenge.method: Extracted the text between the ASF file's opening /* and closing */ and decoded the SPDX JSON licenseText field. Verified both inputs contain only ASCII, lowercased each, extracted maximal [a-z0-9]+ runs, and compared the arrays in order. As boundary checks, repeated tokenization with the whole ASF file and with the SPDX standardLicenseTemplate. Checked the annotated tag's target type and SHA against the detail URL.
challenge.results: All 362 body tokens matched, including the heading, numbered conditions, disclaimer, and trailing attribution. Including the ASF preface yielded 425 tokens. Substituting the SPDX template yielded 497. Both changes broke equality. The tag target was a commit with the exact claimed SHA. The differing locator and crossRef metadata do not contradict the independently reproduced comparison.

limitations: The comparison excludes the ASF preface and ignores comment decoration, punctuation, whitespace, and case. It establishes ordered token equality for these two representations. Byte identity, legal equivalence, and applicability to individual works require separate evidence.
The Apache seeAlso URL differs from the captured plaintext URL, and its crossRef entry reports match as the string “false”. The correspondence rests on direct comparison of the identified texts.
The release binding rests on the SPDX repository's GitHub tag object. GitHub reports the tag as unsigned.
reasoning: The SPDX v3.29.0 annotated tag targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. At that commit the detail record gives licenseId “Apache-1.1” and name “Apache License 1.1”. Independent comparison of its decoded licenseText with the complete commented ASF example produced 362 tokens on each side, equal at every position.
